defects.resolution_evidence: SW2-01 Governance Engine V2 was accepted with the exit criterion that one canonical immutable scan produces reusable facts for generators and validators; the current engine/project-snapshot regressions continue to prove snapshot parity and reuse.
defects.summary: Documentation sync and validation can invoke the compiler/source extraction repeatedly for the same candidate snapshot.

defects.resolution_evidence: SW2-01 accepted the immutable ProjectSnapshot contract. Current sequence_contract.py resolves source files/digests through the active snapshot when present instead of forcing a second repository traversal, and the snapshot regressions remain permanent CI evidence.
defects.summary: Source facts and source digest perform repeated repository traversals and reads instead of sharing one immutable scan snapshot.

defects.evidence: consumer sequence artifacts audited at SW2-00 start
defects.resolution_evidence: SW2-03 Sequence V2 was accepted with separate full machine evidence and bounded human-facing module-collapsed views; the permanent sequence lane continues to regenerate and render the current human Mermaid view while preserving the full graph.
defects.summary: Generated actual sequence diagrams can expand to large low-level helper graphs that are technically evidence-rich but poor human documentation.

defects.resolution_evidence: SW2-03 Sequence V2 made Mermaid syntax/render validation blocking. The permanent SW2 Sequence Evidence context renders the current human diagram through Mermaid CLI and fails if rendering does not produce an SVG.
defects.summary: Documentation quality validation does not currently prove Mermaid syntax/renderability.

defects.resolution_evidence: SW2-00 Baseline & Self-Governance was accepted after adding PROJECT_PROFILE.yaml, .workflow Project Truth authority, generated canonical docs, exact self-governance validation, and repeatable CI evidence for this repository.
defects.summary: Skill Workflow did not govern its own repository with PROJECT_PROFILE.yaml, .workflow project truth, and canonical generated docs before SW2-00.

defects.evidence: GitHub branch metadata and empty repository ruleset list at SW2-00 start
defects.resolution_evidence: SW2-07 accepted the explicit Owner-approved no-ruleset boundary. Automatic GitHub merge protection and required-check enforcement remain intentionally NOT_PROVEN/non-blocking, and repository/project documentation must not claim platform enforcement that does not exist.
defects.summary: The main branch was not protected and had no required status checks or repository rulesets at SW2-00 start.

defects.evidence: SW2-00 baseline run 36971637043 observed synthetic checkout HEAD 86e72f07fc5cc586d250acd61ddfc6e9db115147 while the PR candidate head was 599fbd4c6fe13fc5dcc2d408b0da0150f81a8392; exact-head workflow repair later passed cross-platform.
defects.resolution_evidence: SW2-00 repaired permanent workflows to checkout and validate the exact candidate HEAD; exact-head provenance remains a permanent CI invariant and squash merges use an expected-head guard.
defects.summary: Pull-request GitHub Actions used the default synthetic merge checkout, so successful PR self-tests were not proving the exact candidate HEAD.

defects.evidence: The original self-governance drift gate used git diff --exit-code, which does not report untracked generated files; the replacement git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all gate exposed .workflow/generated/code_facts.json in run 36973054856.
defects.resolution_evidence: SW2-00 replaced the incomplete diff-only drift gate with git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all checks. Current self-governance still fails when tracked or untracked governed outputs drift.
defects.summary: The first self-governance drift check did not fail on untracked generated governance files.

defects.evidence: Run 36973434507 reproduced the false resolve edge. Repair in generate_sequence_actual.py and extract_project_facts.py plus selftest_sequence_call_resolution.py passed Ubuntu and Windows in Governance Selftest run 36973822382. Corrected sequence run 36973822246 removed the false edge and passed per-session plus aggregate validation.
defects.resolution_evidence: SW2-00 accepted the call-resolution repair and its cross-platform regression. selftest_sequence_call_resolution.py remains a permanent Governance Selftest gate.
defects.summary: Static Python call resolution could falsely bind an attribute call on an unresolved expression receiver to an unrelated project function with the same leaf name.

defects.evidence: 2026-10-06 audit: README.md still names v2.0.0 while accepted authority is v2.1.0; CONTRIBUTING.md still claims no Owner-approved license and default-branch deletion/non-fast-forward enforcement; SECURITY.md still says no stable release exists; docs/handbook/reference/versioning.md says stable V2 publication remains blocked under SW2-09; docs/handbook/reference/release-process.md presents SW2-09/SW2-09-R4 as generic future publication semantics; scripts/validate_public_docs.py uses a hand-maintained REQUIRED_PUBLIC_FILES tuple and omits docs/handbook/architecture/analyzer-contract.md plus root community docs.
defects.resolution_evidence: SW2-20 final candidate 173074055f841defd549cc896cfe26a5f60214b4 passed Governance CI run 37398686766 and merged main passed run 37398984162. The deterministic documentation contract classified 124/124 tracked documentation surfaces with zero freshness failures and added add/delete/move/rename plus stale-semantic regressions.
defects.summary: Documentation governance is not coverage-complete: tracked source-authored documents can contain stale semantic claims while current validators still pass because discovery/freshness coverage is partly hand-maintained and dynamic facts are not uniformly authority-bound.
